source: I've obtained proof that Gertrude and Claudius's affair started before King Hamlet's death. When I told Hamlet, he was fully consumed by his desire for revenge. He seems to have a plan he intends to execute during the time period when we would all ordinarily have gathered to watch Peter Quince's performance. I have a bad feeling about this, but if I want to meet this so-called ghost, I'll need to see this through to its end.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Some truly horrific acts occurred, but in the end, the spirit appeared. King Hamlet spoke to me. He waits on the walls each night at midnight. I've been asked to seek him out.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Irma's Ire

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Irma believes Hamlet is in need of some long-overdue discipline, and I've heard her grumbling to the Queen about it. There's no doubt that Hamlet's been difficult for everyone in Elsinore to handle. I wonder if I can force the issue to a resolution.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I saw Hamlet and Irma meet, and the both of them fared worse for it. Hamlet was cruel and Irma only fed the flames. I sense something must come to a head sometime soon.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I can hardly believe what came of all this. Irma poisoned Gertrude and Claudius to death. Not intentionally, of course; she was trying to eliminate Hamlet. But she was summarily thrown in the dungeon. I don't want to think about what Hamlet might do to her next, but I feel some obligation to see this horrible world run its course.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Irma's desire to discipline Hamlet ultimately degraded into a poisoning attempt which took the lives of the King, Queen, and herself. The people I love are capable of such horrors. It's frightening to think about. But I feel as though I understand a little better some of the tension bubbling just beneath the surface. And there's a possibility... that what happened here might help me, somehow, in the future.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Claudius Coming Undone

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: King Claudius clearly holds a lot of power in Elsinore, but at a terrible cost: He killed his own brother. But what I don't know is why. What drives a man to do something like that? Maybe if I got to know the people close to him, I'd find out. It seems like the only person he trusts in the world is his wife, Queen Gertrude.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Reading Gertrude's diary, I feel like I peered through a window into her relationship with the King. I get the impression Claudius has spent his entire life chasing Gertrude, his sole confidante and friend. Now, at last, he has her. I wonder what would happen if he didn't.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Queen Gertrude passed away suddenly today. I noticed Claudius fled from the announcement. I wonder where he went off to.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: When I found Claudius, he was a sodden wreck, out of his mind with grief. And then he asked if I would stay with him as he slept. A duty his wife used to perform. I'm not sure I like where this is headed. Ought I to pursue the matter further? After all, I need only turn back the flow of time, and it'll be as though it never happened... for everyone but me, of course.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I agreed to visit Claudius in his private chambers. And at the end of the night, he made it clear—in no uncertain terms—that he desired to be with me. This is a man I've known since I was a child. It's hard to see him as anything other than Hamlet's uncle. But in his offer there was some implication about the kind of wealth the love of a King can bestow.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Claudius gave me a gift: an heirloom necklace. It's the finest thing I've ever worn, and I'm afraid to accept it. He means to make some grand romantic gesture soon, I think.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Claudius asked me to be Queen, and I consented. All this in a matter of days. Men in this family line seem to move unnaturally quickly when their hearts are similarly moved.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Claudius and I underwent an official betrothal ceremony, to the utter surprise of everyone in Elsinore's court. In a scant few weeks, I'd be crowned Queen. I could rule this country, because the one who holds Claudius's heart holds all of him. Gertrude never used that power to her advantage... but I could. Is that right? More importantly, is that a future I want?

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: The Playmaster

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I met an odd man named Peter Quince who seems to be a wandering actor of sorts. He's going to perform here in Elsinore Castle and has invited me to attend his performance.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Quince wishes to discuss something with me in private about his performances. His only requirement is that I've attended his play first, and then come to see him the morning afterwards in the Gallery.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Two things have become abundantly clear. The first is that Quince is outside the flow of time, as I am. And the second is that his plays are little more than cruel improvisation. He's decided to grant any request I might make regarding a subject for one of his plays. Judging by the reaction King Claudius had to the play about him, this might become useful to suss out more information from audience members.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I happened upon Quince in the gallery, where he and I exchanged a few words. He spoke to me about tragedy and referenced a tale I'd never heard about before. I don't know what to make of him. Is he teasing me or trying to help me, or both?

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Quince performed a little side show in town, and it was odd, to say the least. If his story is to be believed, he's not only immortal, but some great godlike tool of his has been stolen from him. He's here in Elsinore to try and find it.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Quince visited me in my bedroom. He and King Hamlet's ghost are acquainted already. In fact, the both of them are outside the flow of time, like me. Quince claimed that I can find a way to stop the flow of time from repeating. But if so, how? The spirit must be connected.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: King Hamlet's final notes mentioned Quince as 'The Playmaster.' He writes that Quince 'relieved' him of his eternal torment, which explains why he's a spirit in my world and no longer trapped in time. But if Quince has the power to do that, why hasn't he done it for me? What's clear is that all paths seem to lead to me finding this book--this 'Hand of Dionysus.' I'll need to do that before I can understand more.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: He lied to me. He's been lying to me this entire time. He's no friend of mine, and he's not here to help me. He tricked me into fetching this book from Simona for him, and then intended to deceive me into using it so that he can have it back.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source:
We did it. We killed him. We're free. We're really free. Is it over? It must be. I can hardly believe it.

The rest of my life begins today.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: King Hamlet said it best: There will be no way out from this. The Playmaster cannot be defeated or outsmarted. This tragedy is inescapable. But within the confines that bind me, there is choice. That's all I have left to cling to.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Queen Astrid's Memory

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: In various places, I've heard mention of Queen Astrid - Hamlet's grandmother - but I've realized I don't know much about her reign. I could ask around to learn more.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: King Hamlet expressed to me that his mother, Queen Astrid, may have also experienced loops. I've grown up hearing so little about her and her legacy. There must be more to find.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: If I talk to Father about Queen Astrid, he acts evasive. Evidently, the Queen was quite close to my mother, and he finds it painful to discuss her. He mentioned that he visits her grave Thursday night, though...

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I've learned that my mother Elise kept an account of Astrid's story... and it might exist somewhere. My mother contracted plague and was sent away to die in a sanitarium off the southern coast, alone and frightened, by King Hamlet. After she perished, her belongings—along with those of other victims—were brought back by ship and sealed in a small shed near the docks. Perhaps I can learn more information there, if I can find a way in.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: The tale of Queen Astrid turned out to be a complex one, involving her husband, his mistress, Simona, and... my mother. I got help retrieving my mother's belongings from the shack on the docks, and the notes she kept were... strange, to say the least. Simona was trapped in a loop as well, it seems, but what was this about a book? About choosing to be Queen? And could she really have escaped Elsinore alive?

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Gertrude's Chambers

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: The door to Gertrude's chambers is locked - but I won't let that stop me. There has to be a way to get inside. Someone close to her must know, surely.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I've tried asking around about permission to enter Gertrude's chambers. It seems as though only Lady Brit and Irma have keys to enter at the moment.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Brit agreed to lend me her key - if I set her up for a 'private rendezvous' with Hamlet. Well, if it's what I need to do, the task seems straightforward enough. I'll just try not to think about the consequences.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Irma tells me she would be willing to give me her key to Gertrude's room - if I organize a card game for herself, Lady Brit, Horatio, and Marcellus. I'll have to talk to each person she mentioned individually.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Gertrude's private chambers are always locked when time resets, but now I know how to get inside. The key is hidden in the shrubbery outside the Queen's door - if I retrieve that key, I'll be able to enter freely from now on.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: To Catch A Spy

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Bernardo suspects that there is a spy in Elsinore castle, stealing sensitive information and passing it on to unknown forces. I wonder who it could be.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: There is a spy in Elsinore Castle, and I have to find out who it is. If I cannot, then come Saturday morning, I die. But where would I start? Who could help me?

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Bernardo is running his own investigation, interviewing people about what they know. If I send people to him, perhaps I could learn something by observing the meetings he has with them.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: Someone has suggested my brother could help, but Laertes leaves for Paris early Thursday morning. I wonder if I could convince him to stay?

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白

source: I can convince Laertes to stay if I tell him of my fears before he leaves. I'm not sure what will come of it, but my brother is determined to unravel the potential threat. I should follow him.

context.type: 资料、界面或未定位对白
